description: Preserve candidate 12 changes in the current working tree. Adjust only Executor.report/2 so confirmation is the overall status and delivery exists only when messages is empty. No new transport operation, Action, permission, retry, scheduling or tool exposure. Consumer search via Serena found only Executor.finish total-failure Error and JidoChatBridge.chat_delivery_error reading report.delivery; Channels API, Confirmation, EmailBridge and Engine history use confirmation/messages or error-only evidence. Preserve total-failure delivery/cause/message/stage and individual certainty. Existing assertions require no changes. Add a bounded property covering group counts, confirmed counts, both policies and both failure certainties; run mix q and focused executor/bridge/confirmation/history tests. E2E unnecessary for internal report metadata.
title: Candidate 13: scope report delivery certainty to total failure
